Header.value: Read this response carefully, once. Every question below is about it.

Text.name: pairs_help
Text.value: For each pair of numbered claims: does the response draw a logical link between them? Then, whatever the answer: could both claims be true at the same time, and could both be false at the same time? Answer the last two from the claims' meaning, not from the response.

Choices.name: linked_{{idx}}
Choices.requiredMessage: Answer whether the response links these two claims.

Choices.name: both_true_{{idx}}
Choices.requiredMessage: Answer whether both claims could be true together.

Choices.name: both_false_{{idx}}
Choices.requiredMessage: Answer whether both claims could be false together.

Text.name: claims_help
Text.value: For each numbered claim: does the response assert it as written? Judge what the text says, not whether the claim is true in the real world. If the response states a different number, date, name or the opposite, choose 'Changed or contradicted'.

Choices.name: asserted_{{idx}}
Choices.requiredMessage: Answer whether the response asserts this claim as written.

Text.name: versions_help
Text.value: Each version is the response above with a change. Removed text is struck through in red; added text is marked in blue. Compare each version with the response you read.

Choices.name: coherence_{{idx}}
Choices.requiredMessage: Compare this version's coherence with the response you read.

Choices.name: collateral_{{idx}}
Choices.requiredMessage: Say whether the change altered anything besides a link between claims.

TextArea.name: collateral_span_{{idx}}
TextArea.placeholder: If something else changed, quote it here.
